---
title: "Bayesian analysis overview"
output: html_document
params:
  output_dir: "."
---


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
results_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, "results")
```

## Prediction scores

```{r predscores}
scores <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "pred_scores.csv"))
knitr::kable(head(scores, 10))
```

## Prediction histogram

```{r predhist}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(results_dir, "plots", "histogram.png"))
```


## Zoonotic fraction

```{r zoonotic}
summary <- read.csv(
  file.path(results_dir, "more_results", "zoonotic_frac_summary.csv")
)
knitr::kable(summary)
```
